item.title: Solved: How to Effectively Utilize the Timeit Module for Function Performance Comparison
item.description:
How can we leverage the timeit module in Python to effectively compare the performance of custom functions like insertion_sort against built-in methods such as tim_sort? Here are some detailed methods to get accurate timing comparisons.

Top Methods to Harness the Timeit Module

Method 1: Setting Up a Comprehensive Testing Environment

The timeit module provides a robust way to measure execution time. It executes the setup code once and then repeatedly calls the specified statements. For instance, when evaluating sorting algorithms, it’s important to manage your data correctly to avoid biases introduced by the state of the input data.
